about: Demo patients for Patient 360, in demo order. Every fact below was read from the Bronze sources (Clarity, Bronze_PACS, Bronze_ClinicalDocuments) on 2026-11-08; the imaging-demo studies were added on 2026-11-09. The patients are synthetic (Synthea Coherent); the images come from public archives (LIDC-IDRI, TCGA, Coherent MRI) with synthetic identities attached.

patients.title: Two cancers, two slides, PET/CT and a 4D CT
patients.why: Carcinoma in situ of the prostate in January 2017 and stage 1 non-small cell lung cancer in March 2018, each with its surgical pathology slide and report. A 4D CT that plans his radiotherapy, the tumour moving as he breathes; a whole-body FDG PET/CT in August 2019; the brain-wiring atlas beside his MRI after a stroke in 2003. Cisplatin, paclitaxel, docetaxel and leuprolide. Died in October 2019. 144 visits and 565 lab results.

patients.title: Breast cancer, a pregnancy, then colon cancer
patients.why: Breast cancer in April 2009: her biopsy slide, and a breast slide with AI outlines of every nucleus, a map of immune cells, its frozen section and report. A pregnancy in 2016, with the fetal brain atlas from 21 to 36 weeks. Colon cancer in April 2018: its biopsy slide and a 36-marker immunofluorescence image of colon cancer tissue. A low-dose lung CT in December 2023. Tumour genomes of both cancers.

patients.title: From screening CT to lung cancer
patients.why: A daily smoker with emphysema. A low-dose screening CT in November 2019 found ten nodules, the largest 16.2 mm; a year later the lung biopsy slide confirmed stage 1 non-small cell lung cancer, treated with cisplatin and paclitaxel. Died in December 2025.

patients.title: Lung adenocarcinoma, EGFR exon 19
patients.why: EGFR exon 19 deletion in a never-smoker with three prior cancers; erlotinib at recurrence; AI lung and nodule segmentation.

patients.title: Breast cancer, then colon cancer 25 years later
patients.why: Breast cancer in 1993 and colon cancer in 2018, each with its slide and pathology report; oxaliplatin and leucovorin. A 12.9 mm solitary lung nodule on a screening CT in 2019, a chest X-ray before it, Alzheimer's disease; died in February 2021. 202 visits.

patients.title: Every kind of image
patients.why: Brain MRI in 1992, breast cancer slide in 2004, then a chest X-ray and a screening CT with three nodules up to 12.8 mm in 2021. Stroke with cognitive decline and 26 inpatient stays.

patients.title: Breast cancer treatment and lung nodules
patients.why: Breast cancer in December 2021, treated with epirubicin and exemestane; the surgical slide from June 2022. Five nodules up to 9.5 mm on a screening CT in December 2023, with a chest X-ray and a brain MRI. Osteoporosis on alendronic and zoledronic acid.

patients.title: Colon cancer in a long cardiac history
patients.why: Colon cancer in 2015 with its slide, resolved by 2017. Brain MRI, chest X-ray and a CT with two outlined nodules. Lupus on cyclosporine, coronary heart disease and a heart attack, Alzheimer's disease; died in July 2023.

patients.title: A 39.6 mm nodule after lung cancer
patients.why: Stage 1 non-small cell lung cancer in December 2021, confirmed on the lung slide, treated with paclitaxel and cisplatin. Thirteen months later a CT shows a 39.6 mm solitary nodule; its radiology report is a scanned document. Diabetes with kidney disease; 357 visits and 842 lab results.

patients.title: The largest nodule in the demo
patients.why: A screening CT in January 2022 found four nodules, one of them 44.9 mm, in a patient with emphysema. Colon cancer followed in February 2024, with its slide and pathology report.

patients.title: Fifteen nodules on one CT
patients.why: A low-dose screening CT in April 2019 with fifteen nodules outlined by the LIDC radiologists, the most in the demo, the largest 12.3 mm. A chest X-ray two months before, a brain MRI five months after, and a scanned progress note.

patients.title: Scanned documents beside their text
patients.why: A 19.2 mm solitary nodule on a chest CT in May 2025, recorded as suspected lung cancer, and a brain MRI a month later. Three of her documents are scans (two progress notes and the MRI report), shown next to their text.

patients.title: A scanned pathology report and its slide
patients.why: Prostate carcinoma in situ in April 2023: the pathology report is a scan, shown beside the slide it describes. Leuprolide and docetaxel. A screening CT with five nodules in 2019 and a brain MRI in 2023.

patients.title: The longest record
patients.why: 737 visits, 1,512 lab results and 124 inpatient stays: diabetes with kidney disease on insulin and metformin, coronary heart disease and stroke. Breast cancer in 2003 with its slide, and a 5 mm lung nodule on a screening CT in 2021.

research_about: The oncology research patients: real, de-identified TCGA cases built by the Patient 360 reference app's pipeline (research/patient360), with its descriptions. Display names and primary-care histories are synthetic.

research.title: Breast cancer, HER2-enriched
research.why: ERBB2 amplified and IHC 3+, trastuzumab; liver and bone metastases at day 54 and 83, tumour-free at 5.8 years.

research.title: Gastric cancer, MSI-high
research.why: Truncating MLH1, 2,141 mutations (72 per Mb); died at day 356.

research.title: Endometrial cancer, POLE
research.why: POLE V411L, 13,853 mutations (466 per Mb, 99th percentile), synchronous lung cancer.

research.title: Liver cancer, hepatitis B
research.why: Aged 23, AFP 94,340 ng/mL; AI liver volume 1,896 mL before and 1,049 mL after resection.

research.title: Clear cell kidney cancer
research.why: VHL, PBRM1, SETD2 truncations (3p); sunitinib, axitinib, bevacizumab in ten months.

research.title: Colon cancer, five lines of treatment
research.why: KRAS wild-type, five lines over 5.5 years including cetuximab; prone CT colonography.

research.title: Ovarian cancer, high-grade serous
research.why: Progressed on platinum; three CT scans across treatment.

research.title: Bladder cancer
research.why: BCG for prior non-invasive disease, 40 pack-years, electrical installer; HRD 55.

research.title: Lung squamous cell carcinoma
research.why: 90 pack-years; SOX2/TP63 amplified, CDKN2A deleted; the most lymphocyte-rich slide.

research.title: Oesophageal adenocarcinoma
research.why: Reflux disease; ERBB2 amplified with no HER2 therapy on record.

research.title: Cervical squamous cell carcinoma
research.why: Complete response to chemoradiation and brachytherapy, then nodal relapse; PD-L1 RNA high.

research.title: Prostate cancer, Gleason 8
research.why: Gleason 8, SPOP F133V, positive margins, biochemical recurrence.

research.title: Papillary kidney cancer
research.why: MET Y1230H; AI segmentation of kidneys, mass and cysts; tumour-free at 6.7 years.

research.title: Chromophobe kidney cancer
research.why: AI-measured 49 mL mass; MTOR I2017T; a second kidney primary.
